items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Mathematician’s Claude-Assisted Riemann Hypothesis Proof Certified by Lean and Mathlib Communities
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic數學家與Claude協作的黎曼猜想證明獲Lean與Mathlib社群認證
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge released on November 20 a Lean formalization of a claimed proof of the Riemann Hypothesis (and generalized version for Dirichlet L-functions), developed over about six weeks working with Claude. The Lean and Mathlib communities, endorsed by the Lean FRO and Mathlib Initiative, certified on November 21 that the 17-million-line library compiles, matches Mathlib’s statement of the hypothesis, and passes multiple independent checkers, expressing full confidence in its correctness.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic數學家Levent Alpöge於11月20日釋出與Claude協作約六週完成的黎曼猜想（及狄利克雷L函數廣義版本）Lean形式化證明。Lean與Mathlib社群（獲Lean FRO與Mathlib Initiative背書）於11月21日認證，該1700萬行程式庫可編譯、符合Mathlib對猜想的陳述，並通過多個獨立檢查器，表達對其正確性的完全信心。
items_flat.analysis_en: Machine verification of a multi-million-line formalization marks a practical advance in AI-assisted mathematics, shifting the bottleneck from checking correctness to human understanding of novel ideas; full acceptance still requires expert scrutiny of the underlying mathematical arguments, which remain unpublished in human-readable form.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 對數百萬行程式形式化的機器驗證，標誌著AI輔助數學的實務進展，瓶頸從正確性檢查轉向人類理解新穎想法；全面接受仍需專家審視尚未以人類可讀形式發表的底層數學論證。
items_flat.quote: We have full confidence that Alpöge’s proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct, and we congratulate him on this achievement.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們完全相信Alpöge對黎曼猜想的證明是正確的，並祝賀他的成就。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Chief Scientist Proposes Shared Perplexity-Based Limits on Frontier AI Development
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI首席科學家提議以困惑度為基礎的共享前沿AI發展上限
items_flat.summary_en: On November 22, OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki published “Perplexity and Intelligence,” disclosing internal log-perplexity figures (GPT-3.5 ~0.99, GPT-4 ~0.91, recent models below 0.8, a math-capable model ~0.76) on a held-out codebase dataset and arguing for perplexity as a shared metric. He proposes that labs commit to common limits not to be crossed until monitoring advances (e.g., successors to chain-of-thought monitors), warning of further transformative capabilities in the ~0.68-0.7 window and possible acceleration by 2027. Sam Altman called it the most important OpenAI publication in a while.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月22日，OpenAI首席科學家Jakub Pachocki發表〈Perplexity and Intelligence〉，公開內部對數困惑度數據（GPT-3.5約0.99、GPT-4約0.91、近期模型低於0.8、數學能力模型約0.76），並主張以困惑度作為共享指標。他提議實驗室承諾在監控能力達標前不跨越共同上限，警告約0.68-0.7窗口可能出現進一步轉型能力，並可能在2027年前加速。Sam Altman稱此為近期OpenAI最重要的發表。
items_flat.analysis_en: Publishing concrete pretraining metrics creates a potential cross-lab yardstick for pacing, but the proposal’s effectiveness depends on other labs adopting comparable measurements; it remains a call for voluntary norms rather than an operational constraint.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 公開具體預訓練指標為跨實驗室節奏控制提供潛在基準，但提案成效取決於其他實驗室是否採用可比較測量；目前仍屬自願規範呼籲，而非可執行約束。
items_flat.quote: I further propose common limits, based on perplexity and other measurements, that developers are committed to not crossing until our ability to understand and monitor AI behavior achieves a certain concrete milestone (such as the development of a successor to CoT monitors).
items_flat.quote_zh: 我進一步提議基於困惑度及其他測量的共同上限，開發者承諾在我們理解與監控AI行為的能力達到特定具體里程碑（例如開發出思維鏈監控的後繼者）之前不跨越。
